import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    t_total = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    types = data[idx:idx+n]
    idx += n
    prices = data[idx:idx+n]
    idx += n
    c = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    clients = data[idx:idx+c]

    alive = [True] * n
    type_heaps = [[] for _ in range(t_total + 1)]
    global_heap = []
    for i in range(n):
        t = int(types[i]); p = int(prices[i])
        type_heaps[t].append((p, i))
        global_heap.append((p, t, i))
    for h in type_heaps:
        if h:
            heapq.heapify(h)
    heapq.heapify(global_heap)

    total = 0
    for cl in clients:
        u = int(cl)
        if u == 0:
            gh = global_heap
            while gh and not alive[gh[0][2]]:
                heapq.heappop(gh)
            if gh:
                p, t, i = heapq.heappop(gh)
                alive[i] = False
                total += p
        else:
            th = type_heaps[u]
            while th and not alive[th[0][1]]:
                heapq.heappop(th)
            if th:
                p, i = heapq.heappop(th)
                alive[i] = False
                total += p

    print(total)

main()
